title: Syrian-Style Hearty Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious stir fry dish inspired by Syrian cuisine, loaded with a variety of vegetables and hearty goodness.

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, broccoli, onions)

instructions: Heat stir-fry oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add mixed vegetables and hearty olives, stir-frying for 5 minutes until tender.
Sprinkle Syrian spices over the vegetables and stir-fry for another minute.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
